key.name: active-tab
key.description: Index of the pad shown when the popup opens (0-2).

key.name: tab-names
key.description: Three names; an empty string uses the localized default (Notes, Snippets, Scratch).

key.name: enabled-pads
key.description: Whether each of the three pads is enabled and visible.

key.name: syntax-highlighting
key.description: Enable syntax highlighting for code blocks and snippets.

key.name: markdown-styling
key.description: Enable styling for markdown headings, bold, italic, quotes and lists.

key.name: monospace
key.summary: Use a monospace font in the editor (deprecated)

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the Scratchpad icon in the top bar. The popup can still be opened with the keyboard shortcut when hidden.

key.name: display-mode
key.description: How the scratchpad appears: as a dropdown popup, or as a full-height sidebar on the left or right edge of the screen.

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Where the indicator sits in the top bar

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens/closes the popup
